name: Magnetoresistive element
summary: This representation identifies a resistive element whose response is associated with a magnetic field.
description: This representation identifies a resistive element whose response is associated with a magnetic field. The component is a resistive sensing element associated with a magnetic field. It can participate in a larger measurement circuit rather than providing a ready-made contact output.
Identify any bridge, conditioning or controller input associated with the element. A magnetically operated switch has a different electrical output description.
readingNotes: Document the sensing circuit and output conditioning separately.
A magnetoresistive element is distinct from a magnetic contact switch.
